autolocate_AUY359_roi.png is the lossless 256x96 normalized grayscale crop dumped by the actual autoplate_core full-scene regression (AUY359, detected bbox 24,24,240,92). It is derived from an existing calibration photograph, not an independent accuracy sample. The fixture records the dark surround / plate rim failure so the boundary-mask fix can be tested without rerunning the whole locator. No OCR templates or acceptance limits are changed.
